ownership.CORE: Provider identity, capability taxonomy, metadata policy, readiness semantics and discovery
ownership.API: Provider authentication, SDK clients, signed requests and remote storage operations
ownership.ENGINE: Upload, download, replication, lifecycle and restore execution orchestration
ownership.DATABASE: Operational metadata, ownership, indexing, billing and audit records
ownership.STORAGE: Actual object, file, block and backup data persistence

prohibited_cross_layer_responsibilities: CORE must not store file bytes or media payloads
CORE must not execute provider API calls
CORE must not contain raw credentials or secret material
CORE readiness must not be represented as live provider health
